## Checklist

- [ ] Formatter, linter and type checker pass
- [ ] Unit tests for new behavior / regression test for bug fixes
- [ ] Integration tests for changes that cross a boundary
- [ ] Every function has a docstring or JSDoc
- [ ] README/docs updated if behavior or setup changed
- [ ] Under ~400 changed lines (or explained below)
- [ ] No secrets, generated files or build output committed
- [ ] New dependencies approved (reason, license, maintenance status stated)
